checklist.neighbours_confirm: Neighbours confirm the customer lives or works here
checklist.utility_bill_seen: Saw a recent utility bill in the customer's name

list.title: Field surveys
list.description: Home or work visits before an installment sale. A manager assigns the visit, the employee fills it from a phone, then a manager approves or rejects it.
list.emptyHint: Surveys show here once they are assigned from a customer's page.

card.title: Field surveys
card.hint: Visits to the customer's home or work. The latest approved survey of the last {days} days counts toward the credit score.
card.blockedHint: A blocked customer can't get a new survey.
card.emptyHint: Assign a visit to an employee to fill from their phone.

assign.title: Assign survey
assign.description: Choose the employee who will visit {name}.
assign.assigneeHelp: Employees who may fill surveys. Marked ones have their own permissions: the survey goes to them only if they may fill surveys.
assign.selfOnly: You can't see the employee list, so you can only assign the survey to yourself. Ask the owner to assign it to someone else.
assign.instructionsHelp: Optional, up to 500 characters. For example: ask for the electricity bill.

fill.title: Fill the survey
fill.notAssignee: This survey is assigned to another employee.
fill.notOpen: This survey can't be changed: it is no longer open.

location.title: Location
location.hint: Capture the location while you are at the customer's.
location.low: The location is not accurate (more than {m} m). Try again in an open place.
location.denied: Location permission was denied. Allow location for this site in the browser settings, then try again. The survey can't be submitted without it.
location.unavailable: Couldn't find the location right now. Try again.
location.unsupported: This browser can't share its location.

photos.title: Photos
photos.hint: Photograph the home or workplace. At least one photo and at most {max}. Photos are private: only allowed users can open them.

fill.submitDescription: After submitting, the answers can't be changed and no photos can be added.

missing.criteria: a rating for all six items
missing.checklist: an answer for every checklist item

fill.draftRestored: Unsaved answers on this device were restored.

page.title: Survey of {name}
page.notFoundHint: It may have been cancelled, or it isn't assigned to you.
page.lowAccuracy: The location is less accurate than {m} m: check before approving.
page.photosHidden: Opening the photos needs access to the customer's private data.

decide.noteRequired: Write why it is rejected (at least 3 characters).

reassign.title: Reassign the survey
reassign.description: The answers and photos saved so far stay as they are.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel the survey?
cancelDialog.description: A cancelled survey stays in the history. For a new visit, assign a new survey.
cancelDialog.reasonRequired: Write why it is cancelled (at least 3 characters).

credit.residenceScoreOnly: From an earlier approved survey, score {score}

policyHint: Uses the financed amount (cash price minus down payment) and needs a survey approved in the last {days} days.

errors.SURVEY_NOT_FOUND: The survey doesn't exist or isn't assigned to you.
errors.SURVEY_ALREADY_OPEN: This customer already has an open survey.
errors.SURVEY_ASSIGNEE_INVALID: The survey can't go to this employee: they must be active and allowed to fill surveys.
errors.SURVEY_NOT_ASSIGNEE: This survey is assigned to another employee.
errors.SURVEY_WRONG_STATUS: The survey's status changed. Refresh the page.
errors.SURVEY_PHOTO_REQUIRED: Add at least one photo before submitting.
errors.SURVEY_SELF_DECISION: You can't approve or reject a survey you did yourself.
errors.SURVEY_REQUIRED: This sale needs an approved survey of the customer.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You don't have permission for this.
errors.SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED: The subscription has ended: you can only view.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some values aren't valid. Check them and try again.
